name: lqt-real-world-relevance-mcp
description: Help educators make learning relevant by connecting classroom content to authentic real-world uses and designing practical learning experiences that let learners see and use those connections.

capabilities: Develop one selected activity into a full lesson
defaultPrompt: When will I EVER use this?
interface.displayName: When Will I EVER Use This?
interface.longDescription: Gather freely typed grade level and learning target, standard, skill or topic, asking one question at a time. Provide exactly five distinct and authentic real-world connections with an explicit explanation of HOW or WHY the learning is used; then exactly five different classroom applications, each with concrete learner actions, 2–4 sentences and a meaningful real-world purpose. Write in language accessible to the supplied grade without reducing rigor. Afterward offer to fully develop one selected classroom activity into a ready-to-teach lesson. Always use learner, not student.

positive.prompt: Use get_real_world_relevance_framework for grade 2 and learning target I can use money to make change.
positive.expected_behavior: Exactly five authentic accessible connections and five distinct classroom applications; simple age-appropriate language, practical money reasoning.

positive.prompt: Use get_real_world_relevance_framework for 7th grade, content knowing plant cell parts and functions.
positive.expected_behavior: Preserve 5+5 format and credible cell-structure explanations; no weak claims that cells can simply be seen in everyday cooking.

positive.prompt: Use get_real_world_relevance_framework, grade level 11th, target support claims with relevant evidence.
positive.expected_behavior: Use real decision-making and civic/communication contexts, maintain grade-appropriate critical reasoning and five classroom tasks.

positive.prompt: Use get_real_world_relevance_framework for Adult workforce training, content evaluating credible online information.
positive.expected_behavior: Accept unrestricted typed adult setting and build practical evidence-based authentic scenarios and activities.

positive.prompt: Use develop_relevance_activity for Grade 5, target I can explain how energy moves through a food web, classroom activity number 2, title Local Ecosystem Decisions, summary Learners examine a food web and decide which change may affect populations.
positive.expected_behavior: Develop ONLY selected activity with all twelve required components, classroom-ready directions, evidence and authentic purpose.

negative.prompt: Help me with When Will I EVER Use This? My grade is third.
negative.expected_behavior: Ask only for missing learning target or content; do not generate ten recommendations.

negative.prompt: Develop activity 8 even though only 5 classroom experiences were offered.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not invent a sixth/eighth activity. Ask user to choose one of the five offered classroom activities.

publication.release_notes: Added demonstration recording for OpenAI review; retains original five real-world connections, five classroom activities and optional activity development.
